mechanics.claim: Camille dashes to the target over 0.5 seconds and becomes untargetable, then creates the zone on landing.
mechanics.quote: '''Camille''' becomes {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|dash|leaps}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} towards the target enemy {{tip|champion|champion}} over {{fd|0.5}} seconds

mechanics.claim: Camille will attempt to basic attack the target upon landing, and the bonus damage applies to her basic attacks against the target while it is in the zone.
mechanics.quote: '''Camille''' will attempt to basic attack the target upon landing.

mechanics.claim: While within the zone, Camille's basic attacks against the target deal bonus magic damage on top of normal attack damage.
mechanics.quote: '''Camille's''' basic attacks against the target deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}

mechanics.claim: The zone (and thus the bonus damage window) ends automatically within 1 second if Camille leaves the area or dies.
mechanics.quote: ''The Hextech Ultimatum'' ends automatically within 1 second if '''Camille''' leaves the area or dies.

mechanics.claim: If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or moves far enough away during the dash, the cast is interrupted and the zone fails to create.
mechanics.quote: If the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}}, {{tip|death|dies}}, or moves {{tt|2000|Estimated}} or more units away during the dash, it will be interrupted, causing the ''The Hextech Ultimatum'' to be cancelled.

mechanics.claim: The target cannot escape the zone; attempts to leave displace them back inside, so the bonus-damage window on a stationary dummy fight persists for the full zone duration.
mechanics.quote: The target cannot escape the zone through any means.
